Gohl Clinic of Chiropractic – your trusted source for Gonstead chiropractic care in North County San Diego, proudly serving Carlsbad, Encinitas, Oceanside, Vista, San Marcos, Escondido, Rancho Santa Fe, La Costa, Camp Pendleton.

We specialize in the Gonstead System, a precise, science-based approach to chiropractic that targets the root cause of spinal issues. Using detailed analysis and specific adjustments, we help restore alignment and function without unnecessary rotational force.

We care for patients with:

Back and neck pain

Migraines and headaches

Disc injuries and sciatica

Poor posture and nerve issues

Sports and accident-related injuries

All organic conditions

Whether you're in pain or seeking peak function, we’re here to help.
